//: Build this project with TeX Live 2021 (the version Overleaf pins). The user profile uses TeX Live 2023, which cannot compile nidanfloat (see NOTES.md). LaTeX Workshop cannot branch tools/recipes by OS, so both a Windows and a Linux/macOS recipe are defined. latex.recipe.default is a recipe name: it is set to the Linux recipe here; on Windows change it to "latexmk (TeX Live 2021)".
